trace.claim: The supplied evidence does not establish a definitive ranking of gross new-store openings for September 14, 2024–September 14, 2026.
Titan, Kalyan Jewellers and Malabar Gold & Diamonds are the strongest supported expansion candidates among the retailers reviewed, rather than a verified top three by gross openings.
Titan had 991 domestic jewellery stores on September 30, 2024.
Titan had 1,227 domestic jewellery stores on June 30, 2026.
Titan’s disclosed domestic jewellery network counts imply 236 net additions between September 30, 2024 and June 30, 2026.
Kalyan Jewellers had 303 group showrooms, including Candere and overseas locations, on September 30, 2024.
Kalyan Jewellers had 524 group showrooms, including Candere and overseas locations, on June 30, 2026.
Kalyan’s disclosed group network counts imply 221 net additions between September 30, 2024 and June 30, 2026.
India Ratings reports Malabar’s Indian network as 208 stores at the FY2023–24 baseline.
India Ratings reports Malabar’s Indian network as 251 stores in FY2024–25.
India Ratings reports Malabar’s Indian network as 280 stores on March 25, 2026.
Malabar’s Indian network increased by 72 stores from the FY2023–24 baseline through March 25, 2026.
The three network comparisons differ in geographic and brand coverage, and Malabar’s comparison uses different dates, preventing an apples-to-apples gross-openings ranking.
The supplied evidence lacks comparable, complete gross-opening totals.
